routing.title: Account routing
routing.description: Choose per provider how requests are spread across its signed-in accounts. An account that has hit a usage limit is always skipped while another account still has room.
routing.accounts: {count, plural, =0 {No accounts} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
routing.method: {strategy, select, inherit {Per model alias} smart {Smart} quota_balanced {Most headroom} quota_expiring {Soonest reset} round_robin {Round robin} priority {Priority} least_inflight {Least in-flight} other {{strategy}}}
routing.hint: {strategy, select, inherit {Each model alias decides, using the method set on the Models page.} smart {Spends quota that is about to reset and avoids accounts close to their limit. Weighs headroom, reset time, and running requests.} quota_balanced {Picks the account with the most room left on its tightest limit.} quota_expiring {Picks the account whose tightest limit resets first, so quota about to renew gets used.} round_robin {Rotates through the accounts in turn so they wear evenly.} priority {Uses the account with the highest weight first and moves on when it is limited or cooling down.} least_inflight {Sends each request to the account with the fewest running requests.} other {}}
routing.label: Method for {provider}
routing.single: Only one account is signed in, so the method makes no difference yet.

antigravity.title: Google OAuth client
antigravity.description: Antigravity sign-in needs the secret of Google's public OAuth client. It is stored sealed and never shown again.
antigravity.label: OAuth client secret
antigravity.hint: Paste the client secret of the Antigravity desktop OAuth client. Without it, signing in is disabled.
